**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

Section 24 sits at or above our preferred position on every material term:

- **24.1** — Customer may assign without Vendor consent to an Affiliate or M&A successor; only prompt notice and assignee assumption are required.
- **24.2** — Vendor may not assign, delegate material performance, or transfer by change of control without our prior written consent (not unreasonably withheld), and never to a direct Customer competitor.
- **24.3** — Residual assignments are subject to a mutual not-unreasonably-withheld/conditioned/delayed consent standard.
- **24.4** — Our change of control gives Vendor no right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees, or reduce service, and Vendor must cooperate with successor administration.
- **13.3** — Licence rights travel with a Section 24 permitted assignment, closing the usual gap.

I also checked for stray change-of-control triggers elsewhere; Section 9.2 is a standard insolvency right that expressly excludes lawful reorganizations that do not impair performance, so it creates no back-door exit on our restructuring.
